Messages.Body:
If a titled vampire has Pentex Subversion on him/her, can he/she
still vote?

Thanks y'all
Matt

Messages.Author: John H. Wrightson
Messages.Body:
Ma...@worldcom.com wrote:
: If a titled vampire has Pentex Subversion on him/her, can he/she
: still vote?

yes, but he can't take actions to call votes.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Ma...@worldcom.com wrote:
> If a titled vampire has Pentex Subversion on him/her, can he/she
> still vote?

Yes. Pentex merely prevents him from acting and blocking.

He can still vote, playe reaction cards, play action modifiers
(like Cloak the Gathering superior), use any special abilities
(except for taking actions), play cards in combat, etc.
